label: Amazon DSP
terms_note: Same Amazon Ads API onboarding as sponsored ads (approved application required)

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Login with Amazon, same Amazon Ads API credentials; DSP calls scoped by dspAccountId / manager_account_id)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (reporting + audience tooling confirmed; DSP order / line-item management not verifiable this pass).
auth: 1. Login with Amazon app approved for the Ads API (see `amazon_ads.md`); the advertiser grants access to a DSP advertiser / entity.
2. `Authorization: Bearer`, `Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId`, and the DSP account id (`dspAccountId`) / `manager_account_id` where the collection uses them.

endpoints.notes: startDate, endDate, format, type (CAMPAIGN / INVENTORY / AUDIENCE…), dimensions[], metrics[]

endpoints.call: Persona builder (`Amazon DSP › Persona builder`, 5 requests)

endpoints.notes: instance id, SQL query, audience metadata

endpoints.call: DSP orders / line items / creatives create + update
endpoints.purpose: **not in the official collection** (TODO(verify) in the Advanced Tools Center "DSP" section)

reference.limits: - Per-endpoint throttling (429). DSP access: self-service DSP subject to Amazon approval and spend minimums, or managed service; fees via the DSP.
mcp_sdk: Official Postman collection (github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs). No SDK / MCP.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

config_fields.name: api_host
config_fields.help: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

config_fields.name: profile_id
config_fields.help: Advertising profile id of the DSP entity (from GET /v2/profiles; accountInfo.type must be `agency`), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

me.note: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

list_accounts.note: GET /dsp/advertisers (startIndex/count, max 100): DSP advertisers of the configured DSP entity profile ({advertiserId, name, currency, url, country, timezone}).

not_offered.get_report: DSP reports are asynchronous: "POST /accounts/{dspAccountId}/dsp/reports" then "GET …/dsp/reports/{reportId}" until the file is ready (Amazon Ads API Postman collection, https://github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs, Reporting > DSP report); the runtime has no report polling.
not_offered.list_campaigns: DSP orders / line items are not in Amazon's public API collection and their reference page (https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/dsp-orders/) answers "The requested document was not found"; not mapped rather than guessed.
not_offered.update_budget: No publicly documented DSP order/line-item update endpoint could be opened (see list_campaigns).
not_offered.pause_resume: No publicly documented DSP order/line-item update endpoint could be opened (see list_campaigns).

evidence: probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://d1y2lf8k3vrkfu.cloudfront.net/openapi/en-us/dest/Profiles_prod_3p.json: 0/1 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: me: spec says "path not in spec: GET /v2/profiles/X1X"; waived: Amazon's published Profiles OpenAPI (Profiles_prod_3p.json) lists GET /profiles; the adapter uses GET /v2/profiles, the path on Amazon's reference page and in its SDKs. Both answer 401 with a dummy token while an unknown route answers 403 'Invalid key=value pair … in Authorization header', so both routes exist. 1 tool(s) have no machine-readable spec
